blockbuilder-explorer.visual_critic_note: Dark theme and self-encoding color dots in the COLOR USAGE panel show intentional design, but the network diagram suffers from label crowding and the overall feel is competent developer tool rather than publication-quality.
blockbuilder-explorer.encoding_integrity_note: Honest encoding throughout: zero-baseline bars, scaleSqrt for network nodes, data-driven domains via d3.extent/d3.max, and fixed Y-axis on filter for subset robustness.
blockbuilder-explorer.cognitive_load_note: Four linked crossfilter views stay within working memory limits and the pre-computed 60-node network shows readable hub structure, but the color-scatter panel is a dense field of thousands of tiny points that blurs into visual noise rather than a legible hue-lightness distribution.
